concepts.name: Little Guardian
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Deliver ONE square exploratory app icon, not a board or mockup. Reference image is concept reference only: the visual joke of a dog seen from behind, tail raised, traditional dark keyhole immediately beneath the tail. Create original artwork freshly composed according to this direction, not a copy of the reference. Background must be uniform solid deep plum #241E32, opaque edge-to-edge square with NO baked rounded outer corners, no text, labels, words, borders, watermarks or props. Flat vector-like illustration, strong silhouette, restrained detail, no gradients, highlights, texture or realistic fur. Keyhole = circle directly joined to a short tapered stem, prominent and unobstructed, approximately 18% of canvas height. Friendly cheeky humor, no anatomical marks besides the abstract keyhole, no existing cartoon character. Entire emblem within about 76% of canvas with generous margins. DIRECTION 01 LITTLE GUARDIAN: complete compact golden-apricot dog viewed directly from behind. Small rounded head and two floppy ears establish dog, wide rounded rear, short sturdy back legs and two simple paws, NO FACE visible. Tail medium length curves up and right, distinctly shorter and lower than the reference so it does not dominate. Apricot body with a single cream rear patch framing the plum keyhole and a cream tail tip, one darker apricot plane may separate ears/body. Roughly 6 to 8 broad shapes, smooth flat fills, very few interior edges, no toe lines. The body is short and compact, rear is its widest part. Logo should feel affectionate and carefully made.
